# A Rust file names what it exports

> A type the product refers to by name should be findable by that name, and a file that hides one is a file you only find by grep.

Applies to `crates/*/src`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **Any file may export anything** (refused by `rust/a-file-names-what-it-exports`) — Works until the crate has forty files, and then finding `SessionState` means grepping rather than looking.

## What keeps it

- `rust/a-file-names-what-it-exports`
